ValidationRule.description: When closing check if the fields "Case Reason" and "Case Detailed Reason" are not empty.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), ISCHANGED(Status), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Resolved" ) ), ISPICKVAL(ER_Reason__c, "" ), ISPICKVAL(ER_CaseReason2__c, "" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These required fields must be completed: Case Reason, Case Detailed Reason
